headline: A 2016 law renames a Omaha, Nebraska Postal Service building after Navy Petty Officer Caleb A. Nelson.
what_it_does: The law names a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 5720 South 142nd Street in Omaha, Nebraska, the Petty Officer 1st Class Caleb A. Nelson Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or what postal rules apply.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016.
